projects.name: Anantara Mina Residences - Mina Al Arab
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Anantara Mina Residences, a premium beachfront branded residential development located on the pristine shores of Hayat Island within the Mina Al Arab community in Ras Al Khaimah.

The project introduces a refined collection of 84 ultra-luxury waterfront apartments and 19 villas. The residences are designed to blend private homeownership with five-star resort services, offering both exclusivity and convenience in a world-class coastal setting.

The apartments range from suites and one- and two-bedroom units to exclusive three-bedroom sky villas. Rising up to 12 stories, they offer direct beach access and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Hajar Mountains. The villas, available in three, four, and five-bedroom layouts, are arranged over three floors and each features a private garden, infinity pool, and dedicated boat dock. All units are finished with contemporary aesthetics inspired by Anantara’s Thai-Arabian design ethos, including floor-to-ceiling windows and elevated interiors.

Amenities include a private beach, infinity pool, Anantara Signature Spa, yoga studio, cinema room, kids’ play area, fitness center, and on-site dining. Residents also benefit from Anantara’s à la carte services such as in-home dining, concierge, valet, and transport by buggy. 

The project is part of the broader Mina masterplan and supports Ras Al Khaimah’s ongoing efforts to enhance its appeal as a luxury residential and tourism destination.

Anantara Mina Residences - Mina Al Arab is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 70.0 million, at design. Developed by Anantara (Abu Dhabi),Minor Hotels,Rak Properties (Pjsc). Lead consultant Jt+Partners. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project is just minutes away from major tourist hotspots like Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure (the world’s largest indoor theme park). Together, these attractions welcome over 10 million annual visitors, making this location a hub of potential and demand.

projects.name: Parkway by Prestige One - Meydan Horizon

This nature-inspired sanctuary, overlooking crystal lagoons, provides a peaceful living experience without sacrificing urban convenience. Designed with a ground floor plus 4 parking levels plus additional 28 floors and roof, Parkway includes approximately 274 units, a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

Amenities include an Entertainment Lounge, Mini Putt Golf, Club Lounge, Kids Play Zone, Yoga Sanctuary, Multi-Sports Court, Family Pool with Juice Bar, BBQ Terrace, Children's Play Studio, Fitness Gym, Outdoor Cinema, and Owners Lounge.

Located in the heart of Meydan Horizon, Parkway offers a lifestyle that seamlessly blends nature with city life. Just minutes from iconic landmarks such as the Meydan Racecourse, residents benefit from proximity to top schools, healthcare facilities, and leisure options, while enjoying easy access to Downtown Dubai and DIFC.

projects.name: Mamsha Garden - Mamsha Al Saadiyat

Residents can choose from two interior design schemes and benefit from resort-style services, including valet, concierge, housekeeping, laundry, a kids' club, and pet-sitting.

The size of the project is 120,000m² (5,000m² retail and F&B, 2,500m² amenity spaces including coworking spaces, cinema, lounge and gym and 13,000m² of garden with swimming pools and exterior amenities). The project amenities include two central pavilions with gyms, yoga, Pilates, and meditation rooms, swimming pools, kids' play areas, a multi-use games area, underground parking, bike storage, and lounges with workspaces. The development also offers restaurants with outdoor terraces, retail shops, a community theater, and separate retail parking, all strategically designed to foster social vibrancy while maintaining privacy for residents.

Mamsha Gardens boasts spectacular views of the Zayed National Museum and the Arabian Gulf. A walkway through the development provides access to the island's top cultural and leisure attractions, while residents can enjoy high-end retail experiences at Saadiyat Grove. The elevated Mamsha Beach, inspired by the French Riviera, promises a sophisticated ambiance with exclusive amenities.

Designed to foster a seamless lifestyle, this development integrates daily activities with the tranquility of its park-like surroundings. Residents can enjoy jogging paths, bike lanes, and charming cafes within a vibrant neighborhood that promotes a lively atmosphere.

A diverse range of amenities caters to various interests, making it an ideal haven for both adventure seekers and those desiring peaceful retreats. From fitness enthusiasts to those looking for quiet reflection, there’s something for everyone. The community offers recreational facilities, including a swimming pool, gym, kids' play area, and BBQ area, all designed to enhance well-being and encourage social interaction. These amenities are conveniently located, ensuring that every aspect of a balanced lifestyle is within easy reach.

Strategically positioned in the heart of Town Square Dubai, residents benefit from quick navigation and direct access to the central park.

projects.name: Bay Grove Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a multi-building complex on Dubai Islands, Deira, featuring four distinct buildings: Bay Grove Residences Building 1, Building 2, Building 3, and Building 4. Together, they will house an estimated 296 premium units, including stylish one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as luxurious four-bedroom penthouses.

Phase 3 of the development, located on the southern coast of Island B, introduces 241 additional residences, thoughtfully designed to elevate beachfront living. This phase includes a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with sea-facing four-bedroom duplexes that offer expansive layouts, curved balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows, providing panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and a seamless connection to outdoor spaces.

The new buildings in Phase 3 are set within a landscaped podium with basement parking and include modern lifestyle amenities such as an infinity lap pool on the upper podium, a fully equipped fitness centre, and a children’s club. Residents will benefit from direct access to Crystal Beach, an adjacent park, and a raised oceanfront pool, all fostering a resort-style environment that blends comfort, leisure, and community.

Nestled in a prime location, the Dubai Islands offer residents an exceptional blend of natural beauty and waterfront leisure. This coastal paradise spans 50 kilometers of expansive waterfront and boasts 20 kilometers of pristine beaches. Enhanced by new infrastructure, including the Infinity Bridge connecting the islands to the city center, it seamlessly merges urban convenience with scenic tranquility.

Residents will enjoy a vibrant community surrounded by lush green spaces, a premium golf course, and upscale waterfront dining, alongside numerous beachside attractions. The complex will also feature a range of amenities, including balconies, BBQ areas, children's play areas, a state-of-the-art gym, leisure facilities, a shopping complex, a swimming pool, and a selection of restaurants, ensuring a lifestyle of luxury and comfort.

Bay Grove Residences - Dubai Islands is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 100.0 million, at design. Developed by Nakheel (Pjsc). Meydan offers seamless access to Dubai's major landmarks, including Downtown and Business Bay, fostering a dynamic and well-connected lifestyle. Renowned for its world-class attractions, such as the Meydan Racecourse and a host of upcoming developments, the area blends vibrant city living with an exclusive atmosphere, making it an ideal location for those seeking both prestige and accessibility.

The development is equipped with a variety of world-class amenities designed to enhance the living experience. Surrounded by lush green spaces, it offers a tranquil retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. Residents can unwind in landscaped gardens, take leisurely strolls along the jogging track, or simply relax in nature. For those prioritizing health and well-being, the complex features a state-of-the-art fitness center, an outdoor gym, a yoga studio, and a multipurpose court. After an invigorating workout, residents can unwind in the steam and sauna rooms or take a refreshing dip in the leisure pool or Jacuzzi.

Additionally, concierge services are accessible via the LEOS app, and the development is secured with 24-hour security.

Strategically located off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubailand, which spans three million square feet, Weybridge Gardens 3, The Alps offers residents a contemporary urban lifestyle surrounded by a vibrant mix of districts and attractions. The towers include meticulously designed apartments, townhouses, and duplex sky villas, all epitomizing modern luxury. Residents can enjoy a serene, temperature-controlled indoor pool, a rejuvenating spa, and a vibrant kids' play area, all designed for ultimate relaxation and enjoyment. The exclusive beach-style pool provides a resort-like retreat, while ultra-modern fitness studios, sports courts, an indoor rock-climbing wall, and a yoga sanctuary cater to wellness enthusiasts. Sky villas offer breathtaking panoramic views with sleek interiors and expansive vistas.


For entertainment, the private cinema and gaming lounge ensure hours of leisure, while executive business hubs and versatile multi-purpose venues provide spaces for work and events. Dedicated areas for private gatherings add to the exclusivity. Convenience is prioritized with premier valet services, luxury elevator access, and a retail space on the ground floor featuring high-end shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

The project involves the construction of Farm Grove by Emaar Properties which is located in The Valley. It offers an exclusive collection of 482 villas, available in 4-bedroom and 5-bedroom configurations, masterfully designed to combine modern sophistication with serene, nature-inspired living Nestled near Al Ain Dubai Road, this prime location ensures excellent connectivity to key attractions like Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, and IMG World of Adventure.

The villas are meticulously designed with elegant architecture and sophisticated interiors, creating refined living spaces that emphasize comfort, modernity, and tranquility. Farm Grove offers residents a perfect retreat, combining urban convenience with countryside charm.

Key Features

  • Entrance & Guard House: A secure entrance with a dedicated guard house ensures privacy and safety.
  • Infinity Pool: Relax at the stunning Infinity Pool, offering breathtaking views and a peaceful ambiance.
  • Yoga Areas: Rejuvenate in tranquil Yoga Areas designed for revitalizing sessions.
  • Fitness Studio: Stay active in the state-of-the-art Fitness Studio equipped with diverse workout options.
  • Kid's Play Area: A vibrant and safe space for kids to explore, play, and spark their creativity.
  • Grand Lawn: A spacious green area ideal for leisure, events, and outdoor activities.
  • Petting Zoo and Animal Farm: Interactive experiences with friendly animals for fun and education.
  • Community Farming Allotments: Dedicated plots for residents to grow fresh produce, promoting sustainable living.
  • Parks and Open Spaces: Expansive areas perfect for relaxing walks and connecting with nature.
  • Desert Majlis and Bonfire: Cozy areas for stargazing and enjoying bonfires under the desert sky.
  • Padel Court: A modern court for exciting padel matches.
  • Volleyball Court: A vibrant space for friendly matches and outdoor fun.

A Unique Lifestyle

Farm Grove embodies a self-sustaining community that fosters a unique farm-to-table philosophy. Residents can cultivate their own produce in private garden plots while enjoying world-class amenities. From golden beach areas to barbecue spots, retail outlets, and dining options, the community promotes meaningful connections and effortless living.

A Tranquil Retreat

Designed as an oasis in Dubai’s exclusive farming destination, Farm Grove is a haven where families can create lasting memories, bask in nature's abundance, and experience the harmony of a close-knit community. It offers an unparalleled blend of urban sophistication and countryside serenity, redefining the concept of modern living.

The project involves the construction of 23 residential buildings across the Celia, Serra and Lacina clusters located at Wadi Al Safa 4.

Ghaf Woods aims to redefine indoor-outdoor living by seamlessly integrating world-class design with the surrounding natural forest environment. The trees will help reduce soil erosion, conserve water, and provide shade, keeping average temperatures 5°C cooler than the city.

In addition to the environmental benefits, Ghaf Woods will promote health and wellness for residents through walking trails, bike loops, pools, fitness facilities, gardens, and a wellness pavilion. The community will also feature a vibrant social/commercial hub called Distrikt with retail, restaurants, and gathering spaces.

projects.name: Madar Mall (Block E) - Aljada
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Madar Mall, a landmark retail and entertainment destination at the heart of the Aljada megaproject in Sharjah. The mall will serve as the anchor attraction and final phase of the Madar district.

Madar Mall will feature a built-up area of 3.9 million square feet, including 1.1 million square feet of gross leasable area (GLA) spread across three levels. It will house over 400 retail outlets and 80 dining options, creating a comprehensive lifestyle and shopping hub.

The mall will also include a wide range of attractions such as an 11-screen cinema, an ice rink, a flagship fitness centre, and a central observation tower with a restaurant at the top. A public square will showcase signature dancing fountains, while lush landscaped surroundings will enhance the visitor experience.

Once complete, Madar Mall is expected to welcome 20 million visitors annually, reinforcing Aljada’s role as Sharjah’s fastest-growing mixed-use community and enhancing the emirate’s position as a hub for culture, commerce, leisure, and family life.

projects.name: Nad Al Sheba Gardens (SH-003) (Cluster E) (Phase 4)
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Phase 4 of Nad Al Sheba Gardens, a premium gated residential community strategically located near Downtown Dubai. This phase includes the development of 188 residential units—comprising 92 townhouses and 96 villas—along with two pool houses. The villas range from four to six bedrooms, while the townhouses are offered in a three-bedroom layout. The architectural design embraces elements of comfort, nature, and community, providing a distinctive residential experience.

Residents will enjoy access to upscale amenities such as a resort-style swimming pool, a yoga lawn, running tracks, and a planned amphitheatre for community events. projects.name: Esme Beach Residences - Dubai Island A
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Esmé Beach Residences, a prestigious residential development by Elysian Developments, located on Island A of the visionary Dubai Islands. This luxurious complex offers a selection of 109 meticulously designed units, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each featuring private terraces for ultimate privacy. Spanning a total construction area of 266,000 sq ft, Esmé Beach Residences combines expansive living spaces with 23,000 sq ft of thoughtfully designed amenities, focusing on well-being, functionality, and modern living.

Esmé Beach Residences is strategically located on the beachside of Dubai Islands A, offering residents both tranquility and effortless connectivity to major Dubai landmarks, such as Downtown Dubai. A new bridge to the mainland ensures convenient access to these iconic areas. The architecture of the development features an ocean-inspired façade with curved walls that reflect the natural beauty of the Arabian Gulf. This stunning design blends contemporary elegance with local natural elements, creating a visually appealing and functional structure that respects the surrounding environment.

The residences at Esmé Beach offer expansive living areas designed for comfort and convenience. Equipped with smart home technology, these homes provide residents the ability to control lighting, curtains, and electronics with ease. From the sixth floor and above, the apartments boast unobstructed, panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. The interior design incorporates organic materials and a muted color palette, creating a serene atmosphere inspired by the natural surroundings of the Dubai Islands.

In terms of amenities, Esmé Beach Residences offers a range of premium facilities, including a rooftop lap pool with aqua cycling equipment, wellness zones with saunas, cold plunges, and experience showers, as well as family-friendly pool areas with poolside cabanas. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy outdoor CrossFit areas, while residents can also take advantage of cycling and jogging trails. The development includes retail outlets, restaurants, and supermarkets to meet everyday needs. Additionally, 24x7 security, parking facilities, and dedicated kids' play areas enhance the comfort and convenience of residents.

At the heart of Esmé Beach Residences is a focus on well-being. The development incorporates amenities such as contrast therapy zones and purified water systems, designed to promote both physical and mental health. The project is not only a residential development but also a lifestyle choice, offering a holistic approach to living that aligns with the demands of modern families and individuals. With its strategic location and emphasis on wellness, Esmé Beach Residences is poised to become a sought-after address in Dubai, setting a new standard for luxury living in the city.

Designed to offer accessible luxury, the residences range from 4-bedroom Perla and Alba townhouses to 5-bedroom Aryam villas, with sizes between 3,315 and 5,414 sq. ft. (308–503 sq. m). Al Hamriyah’s evolving infrastructure, backed by government investments and commercial projects, positions it as a promising location for long-term investors. Property prices in the area remain more affordable compared to neighboring Dubai, with strong growth potential as development progresses. The project’s emphasis on affordability, high-quality living, and sustainable design enhances its appeal to families and investors seeking competitive returns.

Strategically located near key landmarks such as Al Hamriyah Beach, Hamriyah Port, and Mall of UAQ, The View Island offers easy connectivity via major roads, including Min Al Ittihad Rd, Mohammed bin Zayed Rd, and Emirates Rd. This visionary project combines luxury, wellness, and entertainment, offering a one-of-a-kind living experience. The development will feature 1- and 2-bedroom apartments designed with contemporary interiors, incorporating materials such as travertine, wood, and backlit onyx, creating a warm and sophisticated ambiance. The residential spaces are designed to cater to those who seek a lifestyle beyond just a home, focusing on well-being, adventure, and connection.

At the heart of Montage is Portola, a full-floor wellness and entertainment hub, featuring world-class amenities. These include three-tiered swimming pools with over 50 meters of swimmable distance, a lagoon-style children's pool, and a swim-up seating area, enhanced by choreographed mist and lighting effects. The Portola Wellness Hub offers a snow room, Himalayan salt sauna, oxygen therapy room, cold plunge therapy, red-light therapy, and immersive relaxation lounges. Additionally, there is a state-of-the-art 3,000 sq. ft. fitness center and a 900 sq. ft. virtual reality experience room, providing immersive gaming and adventure activities akin to theme park attractions.

Montage is located in a prime waterfront location with easy access to key districts like Downtown Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road, and the upcoming Etihad Rail station. The Al Jaddaf Metro Station is within walking distance, ensuring seamless connectivity to Dubai's business and lifestyle hubs, while providing a tranquil, resort-like environment for its residents.

Located at the heart of Expo City Dubai, one of the region's most visionary urban developments, the residences benefit from seamless connectivity to major highways, airports, and business hubs.

Inspired by the architectural brilliance of Expo 2020’s iconic pavilions, Al Waha showcases cutting-edge design elements, shaded courtyards, and signature ‘Al Waha’ canopies. Each residence is meticulously crafted with high-quality finishes, built-in wardrobes, and premium materials, including sleek timber accents that enhance the refined living experience.

The loft-style apartments are particularly striking, offering double-height ceilings, statement staircases, and open-plan layouts that create a grand, spacious ambiance. projects.name: The Chedi Private Residences - Barsha Heights

The project involves the construction of The Chedi Private Residences, a 52-storey luxury residential tower soaring 254 meters along Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai. This standalone branded residence consisting of 117 branded residences, the first of its kind under The Chedi name, offers an exclusive collection of premium homes, including two- to five-bedroom villas and six- to eight-bedroom mansions.

The residences are thoughtfully designed with villa-sized layouts, high ceilings, discreet private entrances, and expansive terraces offering uninterrupted views of the Dubai skyline, Palm Jumeirah, and Burj Al Arab. Interior spaces showcase refined elegance with travertine stone floors, bespoke lighting, and kitchens by Italian brand Pedini, equipped with Miele appliances. Bathrooms feature spa-inspired designs with Kohler and Hansgrohe fixtures, smart mirrors, and bespoke stone finishes. Each residence also features a private balcony and barbecue area, while the development includes additional amenities like a children's play area and covered parking.

Residents will have access to three exclusive social spaces—The Ground Social, The Resort Social, and The Sky Social—each offering premium amenities such as private dining, a 60-meter lagoon-style swimming pool, an adults-only infinity pool, wellness facilities, private spa suites, a children's pool, a gym, and a cinema. The Sky Social, located at 240 meters high, provides a sunken lounge, Omakase dining, a cigar humidor, and panoramic views.

Additional features include a yoga zone, jacuzzi, and shared pool and spa. Smart living features like biometric access, energy monitoring systems, and automated lighting and acoustic settings further enhance the residences. The development integrates world-class hospitality services, including 24-hour concierge support, butler assistance, and personalized ‘away-from-home’ packages, ensuring a seamless luxury living experience.

projects.name: Therme Dubai - Zabeel Park
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Therme Dubai, the world’s largest and tallest wellbeing resort, is set to rise in Zabeel Park, Dubai, covering 500,000 square feet and reaching 100 meters in height. The landmark project integrates wellness, leisure, and sustainability, redefining urban biodiversity and environmental responsibility. It will feature the world’s largest indoor botanical garden with over 200 plant species, cutting-edge water treatment systems, and sustainable energy solutions.

The resort is designed around three key zones:

  • Play Zone – A family-friendly area with 15 waterslides, interactive entertainment, and experiential art.
  • Relax Zone – Indoor and outdoor mineral pools, steam rooms, and natural treatments.
  • Restore Zone – A thermal complex with saunas, steam rooms, and mineral treatment baths.

Therme Dubai will accommodate 1.7 million visitors annually and include a Michelin-star restaurant, three 18-meter waterfalls, and 4,500-square-meter pools. The project will also include an exciting play area with 15 waterslides and immersive art installations aimed at enhancing the overall customer experience. Its sustainable engineering will recycle 90% of its water and rely on 80% clean energy for cooling.

Beyond leisure, the project aligns with Dubai’s Quality of Life Strategy 2033, which focuses on enhancing community well-being and creating sustainable urban spaces. The design of Therme Dubai reflects Dubai’s commitment to environmental responsibility, with features such as green architecture, energy-efficient systems, and eco-friendly construction materials. The integration of natural elements within the urban setting aims to foster a healthy and vibrant lifestyle for Dubai’s residents and visitors. By incorporating wellness, culture, and sustainability, the project strengthens Dubai’s global position as a wellness and tourism hub.

Therme Dubai - Zabeel Park is a greenfield resort project in Dubai, valued at USD 544.5 million, at design. Developed by Therme Group. Lead consultant Ds+R (Diller Scofidio + Renfro). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Rising 69 metres high and covering 7,896 square meters, the building features a unique configuration of three basement levels, a ground floor, five podium levels designated for parking, eleven upper office floors, and a rooftop.

Azizi Emerald comprises approximately 102 commercial units, thoughtfully laid out within contemporary, high-end interiors. Key features include secured parking, advanced security systems, a dedicated worship hall, and an eco-friendly cooling system that supports sustainable corporate operations. The structure is a freehold property aimed at startups and established enterprises looking for a prestigious base in one of Dubai’s busiest commercial hubs.

The strategic location within Dubai Healthcare City ensures seamless connectivity to nearby landmarks, including Wafi Mall, Max Metro Station, the World Trade Centre, Museum of the Future, and Burj Khalifa. Additionally, the mixed-use environment provides easy access to healthcare services, landscaped parks, and a wide range of dining and retail options.

projects.name: Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ)
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ), a landmark development designed to serve as a distinguished destination for artists, creatives, and intellectuals from both within and outside the country. Strategically located in Sharjah’s educational and innovation hub, the SCQ aims to foster a dynamic community of innovators, providing a platform for talent showcasing and cultural exchange. The development will feature a range of integrated buildings, including cultural spaces, prototyping facilities, and research areas, creating a vibrant ecosystem for creativity and collaboration.

Key elements of the SCQ include:

  • Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Collection: A museum showcasing a curated selection of art and historical artifacts from Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher bint Mohammed Al Qasimi's personal collection.
  • Qasimi Archives: Honoring the legacy of Sheikh Khalid Al Qasimi and inspiring the next generation of fashion designers.
  • Sharjah Fashion Lab: Provides local designers with world-class expertise and technological innovation to develop fashion prototypes and products.
  • Irthi Museum: A museum that promotes and contemporizes Emirati and regional crafts while empowering traditional craftswomen.
  • Sharjah Design Centre: A newly established facility offering mastery in various design disciplines such as woodwork, ceramics, metalwork, textiles, and fine jewelry.
  • L’ÉCOLE, School of Jewelry Arts: The first of its kind in Sharjah and the second in the Middle East, offering courses and talks on the culture of jewelry arts.

The SCQ emphasizes sustainability and integrates with its surrounding landscape. The development will incorporate green spaces, interconnected buildings, and essential amenities such as cafes, restaurants, and co-working areas, ensuring a stimulating environment for all who visit and engage with the space. The project will prioritize eco-friendly materials like rammed earth to minimize its environmental impact.

This visionary development will become a cultural and innovation hub for both local and international communities.

Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ) is a greenfield landmark, museum & galleries project in Sharjah, valued at USD 300.0 million, at design. Developed by Sharjah Art Foundation,Beeah Tandeef. projects.name: Solea Residences - Saadiyat Lagoon District
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Solea, a mid-rise residential development comprising a basement level, a ground floor, 7 additional floors and a roof located on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi. The development consists of four interconnected buildings featuring a contemporary architectural design that integrates modern aesthetics, sustainability, and functionality. Rising seven floors above a basement parking level, the project offers a total of 212 residences, including one- to four-bedroom apartments.

Designed with an interlocking massing strategy, Solea presents a striking architectural identity while optimizing private and communal spaces. The façade blends glass and solid elements, ensuring natural light penetration, privacy, and energy efficiency. The design incorporates sustainable building strategies such as energy-efficient glazing, smart building technologies, and water-efficient landscaping to minimize environmental impact.

The development is centered around a resort-style pool area complemented by landscaped courtyards, shaded seating areas, and pedestrian-friendly pathways. Solea offers resort-style amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and social connection. A sunlit pool, jacuzzi, and kids’ pool provide a serene escape, while landscaped gardens and shaded courtyards offer peaceful retreats. A modern gym, sports courts, and a jogging track cater to an active lifestyle, while BBQ areas, outdoor lounges, and boutique retail spaces create a vibrant community atmosphere.

Residents will have access to premium facilities, including a state-of-the-art gym, an outdoor cinema, and multipurpose recreational spaces. Floor-to-ceiling windows in each residence offer uninterrupted views of Saadiyat Island’s serene lagoons and skyline, enhancing the overall living experience.

Situated within the Saadiyat Lagoons District, Solea provides easy access to major cultural landmarks, including the Louvre Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Cultural District. Its strategic location ensures proximity to world-class hospitality, retail, and leisure destinations, making it a distinguished addition to Abu Dhabi’s luxury residential market.

Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the development ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations, including Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay. The project is designed to offer a wide range of world-class amenities, fostering a vibrant and family-friendly community. For families, the development features a dedicated children’s daycare, splash pads, trampoline parks, wall climbing zones, and a sandpit play area. Additional premium facilities include an indoor gym, a business center, cabana seating, sports courts, and dining outlets, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle. The practical exteriors are designed for easy access, low maintenance, and efficient space utilization. Select apartments come with private swimming pools, adding an element of exclusivity.

projects.name: 106 Villas & 102 Mansions - The Acres - Dubailand
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of an exclusive standalone villa community in Dubailand, offering a range of premium residential units. The final phase includes 106 luxury villas and 102 exquisitely designed mansions, as part of The Acres Estates.

The community offers a selection of 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas, along with the Amber and Ivory Collections featuring 5, 6, and 7-bedroom mansions. Each residence is designed to provide a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living spaces, with centrally located kitchens, grand master bedroom suites, spacious bathrooms, and unique courtyard designs that maximize natural light and privacy.

The Acres Estates offer expansive plots ranging from 9,000 to 17,700 sq. ft., with private gardens connected to green pedestrian pathways leading to the park and lagoon. The Amber Collection showcases a contemporary aesthetic with clean lines and natural materials, while the Ivory Collection incorporates a more traditional design with vertical stone-clad walls and minimalist white horizontal lines.

Residents will benefit from extensive green spaces, with each villa located within a three-minute walk from a park. The community offers a strong social infrastructure, including the Halo Loop Park, a nursery, a school, a clinic, mosques, clubhouses, retail areas, and an Edible Garden. Lifestyle amenities include a trail network, outdoor gym, playgrounds, swimming pools, and sports areas.

Strategically positioned in Dubailand, The Acres provides convenient connectivity with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Emirates Road. It is located just 10 minutes from Global Village and five minutes from Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club and Hamdan Sports Complex, making it an attractive residential destination.

projects.name: Two Signature Villas by 25 Degrees - Palm Jumeirah

The project involves the construction of two ultra-luxury Signature Villas on a beachfront plot near the tip of one of the fronds on Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. These custom-built villas are poised to set a new benchmark for super prime living in the region. The development distinguishes itself by being constructed from the ground up on a previously vacant site, rather than being a renovation of existing properties.

Each villa is uniquely designed to embody a distinct architectural identity. One features floating planes, layered textures, and deep spatial composition, while the other is shaped by smooth, curvilinear forms that blend seamlessly into the horizon. Together, they reflect a harmonious balance between indoor and outdoor living, showcasing double-height lounges, sculptural staircases, and full-height glazing.

The villas are curated as sensory retreats, incorporating infinity pools that stretch toward the Arabian Gulf, sunken seating areas surrounded by reflection pools, cascading water features, and organically designed landscaping to evoke a tranquil atmosphere. They also include formal and informal lounges, ocean-view master suites with spa-style his-and-her bathrooms, expansive walk-in wardrobes, and state-of-the-art amenities.

Each residence features a private cinema, fitness suite, wellness spa, and an exclusive automotive gallery. Rooftop amenities include a plunge pool, alfresco BBQ lounge, and an open-air cinema, all framed by panoramic views of the Gulf and Dubai’s skyline. With direct beach access and bespoke European finishes, the project aims to cater to the growing population of ultra-high-net-worth individuals seeking elite property options in Dubai.

Designed to serve patients across the region, the facility will feature a heavy-ion therapy system that includes : One treatment room equipped with a rotating gantry, a horizontally fixed beam treatment room, high-speed scanning irradiation technology, acompact rotating gantry with superconducting magnets.

Designed as an all-in-one destination, Ardee Al Marjan Island will integrate hospitality, leisure, shopping, and wellness in a pedestrian-friendly setting. Residents and visitors will enjoy direct access to pristine beaches, panoramic sea views, green spaces, and wellness activities. projects.name: Downtown UAQ
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Downtown Umm Al Quwain, a large-scale coastal city spanning 25 million square feet in Umm Al Quwain. Designed as a mixed-use development, it will feature luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality districts, organized into three main areas: North Beach, Trade Centre, and South Beach. A continuous 11-kilometre stretch of coastline, including 7 kilometres of natural beaches and parks, will serve as a signature element of the development, enhancing its appeal for leisure, tourism, and waterfront living.

At the heart of the project lies the UAQ Trade Centre Free Zone, a 15 million square foot business hub operating under an independent legal framework aimed at attracting global investors and fostering economic growth. Downtown Umm Al Quwain will include residential communities, commercial offices, luxurious five-star hotels and resorts, retail destinations, and entertainment hubs. The project is planned to house over 150,000 residents and will dedicate 50% of its land to green spaces, parks, landscaped gardens, and natural corridors to promote a sustainable, high-quality living environment.

The development prioritizes modern infrastructure with a focus on water conservation, marine protection strategies, and ecological harmony, positioning itself as a model for responsible urban growth and a premier destination for investors, residents, and tourists alike.

Downtown UAQ is a greenfield mega urban development project in Umm Al Quwain, valued at USD 3000.0 million, at concept. Developed by Sobha Realty,Government Of Umm Al Quwain. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Bayn by ORA
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bayn, a visionary coastal community development located in Ghantoot, strategically positioned between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Spanning 4.8 million square meters, Bayn is master-planned as a compact and sustainable city, blending dynamic urban living with coastal tranquility. Designed to accommodate up to 32,000 residents, the development balances low-density planning with expansive green and waterfront areas.

Key features of the development include 9,000 residential units comprising mansions, villas, townhouses, and apartments. The community offers over 7 kilometers of waterfront living, including 1.2 kilometers of beachfront with Arabian Gulf views, a marina, lagoon areas, a beach town, and a business park. At its heart lies a 65,000-square-meter business park, complemented by integrated schools, nurseries, retail outlets, healthcare services, wellness amenities, and a 204-berth marina. A 200-key 5-star resort and a 100,000-square-meter sports club further enhance the lifestyle offering.

Approximately 55% of the land is allocated to open spaces, including one million square meters of public parks, landscaped greenways, outdoor activity zones, and a 33-kilometer network of pedestrian, cycling, and running trails linking vibrant hubs like the marina promenade to quieter wellness-focused zones. These open spaces also feature gyms, padel courts, BBQ areas, and playgrounds to encourage community engagement and outdoor living.

Bayn integrates smart, sustainable infrastructure, including solar-powered energy systems, native landscaping for efficient water use, smart waste and water management, and building designs that maximize natural light and airflow. The community’s transportation within the masterplan is based on a 100% eco-friendly system, reinforcing Bayn’s commitment to sustainability.

In terms of urban structure, Bayn is designed with three distinct nuclei — Beach Shore Living, Resort Living, and Town Living — each offering different tiers of luxury while remaining cohesively connected. Commercial components such as a shopping mall, neighborhood parks, sports courts, and a waterpark further enrich the living experience.

Phase 1 of Bayn introduces 464 villas and townhouses across four gated clusters, offering ten distinct home typologies ranging from three to five bedrooms. 

Bayn by ORA is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 3000.0 million, at design. Developed by Ora Developers. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Residents will enjoy access to a clubhouse, along with a curated mix of food and beverage options, as well as retail experiences, reinforcing Bayn’s vision of creating a seamlessly integrated, self-sufficient coastal destination.

With a design inspired by compact city principles, ecological stewardship, and strategic connectivity between Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Bayn’s Phase 1 aims to redefine the UAE’s waterfront real estate landscape, offering a lifestyle that blends social vibrancy with coastal serenity.

Bayn by ORA - Phase 1 is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 144.3 million, at design. Developed by Ora Developers. projects.name: HENGE Residences - Saadiyat Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of ten-storey residential complex located on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi. This high-end residential project is a collaboration with the iconic Italian design house HENGE, marking its debut in the Abu Dhabi real estate market. The development comprises 166 units, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as two duplexes, with a total built-up area of over 400,000 sqft.

The residences are designed to offer a fusion of craftsmanship, elegance, and curated comfort. Each unit features bespoke furniture and materials exclusively selected and crafted by HENGE’s master artisans, providing an immersive experience in artisanal living. The interiors emphasize contemporary aesthetics, with finishes including natural marble, sintered stone, and natural wood accents, embodying a bespoke design ethos.

HENGE Residences is located just 20 minutes from Downtown Abu Dhabi and is close to key landmarks such as the Saadiyat Cultural District and NYU Abu Dhabi. The development is situated in the heart of Saadiyat Island’s Marina District, offering both convenience and a prestigious lifestyle. The project introduces a new standard of boutique, branded residences that blend luxury living with artistic expression.

To enhance residents' living experience, HENGE Residences offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities, including 24/7 security, a padel court, a health club with sauna and steam rooms, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, dedicated children’s pool, smart home automation, and full concierge services. These features, along with the prime location, contribute to a high-end living environment. 

HENGE Residences - Saadiyat Island is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 136.1 million, at design. Developed by Nord Development,Henge. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Chelsea Residences by Damac
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Chelsea Residences by DAMAC, a luxury football-themed residential development located in Dubai Maritime City. 

The master plan comprises six towers across two clusters:

Chelsea Residences 1

  • Tower A: G+2P+25
  • Tower B: G+2P+28
  • Tower C: G+2P+30

Chelsea Residences 2

  • Tower A: G+2P+33
  • Tower B: G+2P+30
  • Tower C: G+2P+33

Together, the development will include over 1,400 premium residential units, offering a mix of apartments and luxury villas, each designed with sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf and access to exclusive Chelsea-branded amenities.

Key features of the development include Chelsea FC-branded fitness and wellness centres, an athlete performance studio, rooftop football pitch, and dedicated areas for aerial yoga and cryotherapy. Residents will also enjoy a private cinema, a Chelsea-themed sports bar, and a community lounge for live match screenings. Dining experiences will be elevated through a mono-diet café and the exclusive Captain’s Table, offering events featuring Chelsea legends. The architecture and interiors will combine Chelsea’s iconic identity with DAMAC’s contemporary design standards, delivering a distinctive and immersive living experience.

By integrating high-end living with elite football culture, Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is set to attract football fans, international investors, and high-net-worth individuals seeking a unique branded lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prominent seafront destinations. 

Chelsea Residences by Damac is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 600.0 million, at concept. Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc,Chelsea Fc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Brabus Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Brabus Island, a luxury branded residential development by BRABUS. Located on a private island in the upscale Al Seef District of Abu Dhabi, the development spans approximately 100,000 square meters and is set to redefine high-end living in the UAE capital.

Brabus Island will feature a total of 450 luxury residences, comprising 350 high-rise apartments and 100 bespoke waterfront villas. The apartments are distributed across four residential towers and offer two- to four-bedroom layouts, ranging from 1,100 to 5,000 square feet. Each apartment is crafted to reflect BRABUS’s signature design identity, with interiors available in modular themes such as Black & Bold, White Bliss, and Gray Haven. Much like the brand’s high-performance vehicles, the residences offer options for customization with premium materials and high-end finishes.

The single-family villas, all positioned on either beachfront or waterfront plots, emphasize privacy and exclusivity. These bespoke homes are designed to maximize views and access to the island’s tranquil environment. Both apartment and villa residents will benefit from direct waterfront access and a wide array of lifestyle amenities tailored for luxury living.

The architectural vision of Brabus Island emphasizes sleek lines, performance-inspired design, and refined modernity. The residences feature floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, Yas Island, and Saadiyat Island. Each home comes fully finished and ready for occupancy, with interiors showcasing natural marble, sintered stone, and wood finishes. Standard features include private balconies or terraces, built-in kitchen appliances, smart home automation, central air conditioning, built-in wardrobes, and fiber-optic high-speed internet connectivity.

In addition to premium living spaces, Brabus Island delivers a world-class residential lifestyle. Amenities include multiple swimming pools for adults and children, a fully equipped gym and health club, sauna and steam rooms, an outdoor jacuzzi, and a private padel court. The development also includes indoor and outdoor kids’ play areas, BBQ zones, and dedicated social lounges. Concierge services and 24/7 security provide residents with convenience, privacy, and peace of mind.

Brabus Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 1000.0 million, at concept. Developed by Brabus Gmbh,Reportage Real Estate Llc,Abu Dhabi Municipality - Roads Department. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Al Marjan Arthouse
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Al Marjan Arthouse Residences, a luxury branded residential development located on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Developed by Dubai-based real estate firm Clédor in partnership with New York’s Arthouse Hotel, the project marks the first international expansion of the Arthouse brand beyond the USA. 

The residences are designed to reflect Arthouse NYC’s distinctive aesthetic—featuring art-driven interiors, refined boutique-style architecture, and curated design elements inspired by its original 1920s-era hotel. Residents can expect elevated service standards and lifestyle amenities that align with the brand’s century-old legacy of hospitality excellence.

projects.name: Granada - Phase 2 - Bloom Living
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the second phase of Granada, a premium low-rise residential apartment community located within a larger master-planned development in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi. Spanning eight four-story buildings, this phase is designed around the principles of traditional Mediterranean architecture blended with modern comfort, offering a fully integrated and inclusive living experience.

Granada 2 is the ninth phase within the broader community, offering 458 modern apartments that range from compact studios to spacious three-bedroom units. It offers a diverse range of units including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all featuring modern finishes, high ceilings, and open floor plans. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with large windows that invite abundant natural light, creating bright and airy interiors. Generous balconies and spacious living areas further enhance the residential experience.

The community caters to multi-generational living, offering residents direct access to an array of high-quality amenities. These include fully equipped fitness centers, cafés, lounge spaces, kids' play areas, shaded playgrounds, and swimming pools. Communal zones throughout Granada are designed with landscaped gardens, decorative façades, and wide courtyards, providing relaxing and luxurious outdoor environments.

In addition to its diverse range of units, Granada 2 emphasizes lifestyle-enhancing amenities. Residents will have access to two fully equipped gyms, two large swimming pools, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, a dedicated prayer room, secure basement parking, and a dedicated sports track promoting an active and connected way of life.

 

Granada - Phase 2 - Bloom Living is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by Bloom Holding Pjsc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.
